subject: fdic-ps01-comment-text

metrics.name: FDIC PS-01/PS-01a weekly reserve-reporting forms comment
metrics.proposal_text: CSOAI proposes that GENIUS Act weekly disclosures be published as signed, machine-readable artifacts using a standard measurement-card schema. Each weekly disclosure would carry: (1) Ed25519 signature over the disclosed reserve figure, (2) timestamp authority (OpenTimestamps/Rekor) proving when the figure was published, (3) inclusion in a public Merkle root for that week, (4) corrections ledger entry for any later revisions. This creates permanent, verifiable audit trail without requiring changes to underlying accounting practices. The CSOAI measurement-card schema (csoai.measurement-card/0.1) provides the existence proof.
metrics.cost: Owner-gated submission, draft Monday Sep 14, file Wednesday Sep 16
metrics.value: Cheapest regulator-door entry on the board. FDIC is the natural weekly-reporting enforcer under GENIUS.

honest_sentence: FDIC PS-01 comment (Sep 18 close, 5 days): propose GENIUS weekly disclosures as signed machine-readable artifacts with csoai.measurement-card/0.1 schema. Creates permanent verifiable audit trail without changing accounting practices.
